class.name: SuperposUdpListener
class.brief_description: Single-port native UDP server socket shared by many Session associations.
class.description: Binds one UDP socket that carries every server-side association attached with [method SuperposSession.configure_udp_listener]. Each client prefixes its datagrams with the connection ID it was admitted with (pass [code]connection_id[/code] in the [method SuperposSession.configure_udp] transport profile); server replies carry no prefix. The connection ID routes and never authenticates: DTLS authenticates the peer with its admission key, and a changed client address (for example a NAT rebinding) receives outbound traffic only after it answers an encrypted path challenge. Datagrams without a prefix, with an unknown connection ID, or anything but a handshake before an association has a path are dropped without a reply or an allocation. Until an address is authenticated, bytes sent to it are limited to [code]amplification_factor[/code] times the bytes received from it, and every association has its own bounded receive queue. Connection IDs come from trusted admission, must be nonzero and must be unpredictable. Every attached Session keeps this listener alive until its network is closed. All methods are main-thread and owner-thread only.

method.name: bind
method.description: Binds a numeric IPv4 or IPv6 [param address] and [param port] (0 picks a free port; see [method get_local_port]). The socket binds exclusively, so another process cannot bind the same address and port. Accepted integer keys are [code]maximum_associations[/code] (1 through 4096, default 256), [code]queue_datagrams[/code] (per association, 1 through 256, default 32), [code]poll_quantum[/code] (datagrams drained per poll, 1 through 4096, default 256), [code]amplification_factor[/code] (1 through 10, default 3) and [code]receive_buffer_bytes[/code] (kernel receive buffer request, 0 keeps the system default, at most 64 MiB). Unknown keys return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]; an address already in use returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] or [constant ERR_CANT_CREATE].

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the socket. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] while any Session association is attached; close those Sessions first.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the error recorded by the last call.

method.name: get_local_port
method.description: Returns the bound port, or 0 when not bound.

method.name: is_bound
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the socket is bound.

method.name: read_status
method.description: Returns [code]error[/code], [code]port[/code], [code]attached[/code] and the shared-socket counters [code]datagrams_received[/code], [code]datagrams_routed[/code], [code]datagrams_sent[/code], [code]malformed[/code], [code]unknown_connection[/code], [code]not_handshake[/code], [code]foreign_during_handshake[/code], [code]queue_overflow[/code], [code]amplification_limited[/code], [code]candidate_paths[/code] and [code]path_promotions[/code].
